items.title: Mastercard unveils Stablecoin Security tool to screen payments for fraud and sanctions risks
items.summary: Mastercard unveiled Stablecoin Security, a risk screening service launching in North America before planned global availability in 2027.

items.title: Banks Hold a Lever Over Stablecoin Adoption, BIS Economists Say
items.summary: A Bank for International Settlements working paper found that stablecoin growth slows when U.S. banks raise deposit rates, with Circle’s USDC most sensitive.

items.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street closes at 4. Tokenized stocks keep trading
items.summary: Tokenized stocks are drawing trading activity beyond Wall Street hours, while Bitcoin miners confront costly AI expansion and new accounting rules could benefit stablecoins.

items.title: Russia Will Soon Ban Peer-to-Peer Bitcoin Trading, Central Bank Confirms
items.summary: Russians have until July 1, 2027 to buy and sell crypto directly with each other. After that, every trade runs through a broker or exchange approved by the Bank of Russia.

items.title: JPMorgan takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients: Report
items.summary: JPMorgan is reportedly expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to make payments and settle tokenized asset transactions.

items.title: SEC tokenized stock framework faces issuer pushback as Broadcom, Verizon object to OKX-ICE listing
items.summary: Eight more companies objected to trading on the planned OKX-ICE venue, while Nasdaq has separately said it would opt out under the SEC’s framework.

items.title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
items.summary: The security firm found that 77% of third-quarter losses involved compromised suppliers, delayed fixes or systems outside the latest security reviews.

items.title: Stablecoin remittances cost 84% less than traditional transfers, report finds
items.summary: Borderless.xyz data shows major savings on cross-border business payments, with stablecoin transfers also settling faster than traditional international bank wires.
